title: BPP MutationMeta (DESIGN.md §14.2): idempotent-mutation metadata carried in Request.meta
description: Required on every mutation. expected_revision is required by update operations (the last observed revision); causation_event_ref and correlation_ref thread provenance into the event ledger (§14.4). Field-level pairing of operation and meta (which ops are mutations, which are updates) is a registry rule enforced in code, not expressible here.

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).
